title: Adult Activity: An Overview
claims: Adults need at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity activity weekly, or an equivalent combination.
Adults also need two days of muscle-strengthening activity each week.
Activity can be spread out and broken up; some activity is better than none.

verification.note: CDC 页面正文完整可读，落地 URL 与源 URL 一致；页面标注 Dec. 20, 2023，与 publishedAt 一致。

claimVerification.note: 关键点：“Adults need at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity a week”；正文“This can also be 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity or an equivalent combination of moderate- and vigorous-intensity physical activity.”
原文：“Adults also need 2 days of muscle-strengthening activity each week.”；正文作“at least 2 days”。
原文：“You can spread your activity out during the week and break it up into smaller chunks of time.”；“Some physical activity is better than none.”
